title: Data Product Entity
description: JSON Schema for Data Product entity in customer workspace (Studio / S3 graph). Flow-graph fields (workflow_id, upstream_entity_id, etc.) describe placement in the workflow canvas. The canonical interoperable catalog and API representation is ODPS v4.1 (Open Data Products Standard): include `odps_document` aligned with https://opendataproducts.org/v4.1/schema/odps.json — see `odps-product.json` and .kiro/specs/odps-data-product-standard in the Loxtep repo.

data_product_id.description: Unique identifier for the data product

organization_id.description: Organization that owns this data product

project_id.description: Project that contains this data product

kind.description: Data product role in the flow (source or consumer)

workflow_id.description: Reference to the workflow that produces this data product

domain_id.description: Optional reference to the domain this data product belongs to

upstream_entity_id.description: Reference to the upstream entity in the flow graph (last transformation, validation, or connection before this data product; source data product in an enrichment flow)

upstream_entity_type.description: Entity type of the upstream entity

upstream_label.description: Labeled edge when the upstream node is an approval (approved or rejected).

logical_key.description: Stable design-time identity shared by stage/prod sibling catalog rows (ADR 0013). Defaults from name slug or data_product_id when omitted.

environment_key.description: Environment segregation key (stage|prod|dev|…). Usually stamped from the target instance on materialization; optional on the design-time entity.

sibling_environments.description: Declared catalog environments for this logical product (ADR 0013 / #4878). Same logical_key + different environment_key are sibling products (new UUIDs on cross-env deploy). Prefer environment_key. Deploy applies a matching declaration and fails closed when the target env is omitted (no silent catalog sibling, no copy of stage runtime binding rows). Omit the field to keep the legacy single-catalog path. Same-env geo belongs on runtime_slots, not here.

environment_key.description: Logical environment (stage, prod, dev, franchise slug, …). Preferred over hard-coded instance UUIDs in git.

runtime_slots.description: Declared per-environment (or per-instance) runtime slots for this data product (queues/bots/storage). Prefer environment_key; use instance_id for same-env geo. Deploy upserts data_product_runtime_bindings from these declarations (fail closed — no silent stage→prod copy). Optional queue_name/bot_id/storage pin external or known handles; omit them when deploy resolves from topology.

environment_key.description: Logical environment (stage, prod, dev, …). Preferred over hard-coded instance UUIDs in git.

instance_id.description: Optional explicit instance pin (same-env geo). When set, matches that instance before environment_key.

queue_name.description: Optional pinned rstreams queue for this env/instance. When omitted, deploy fills from topology.

bot_id.description: Optional pinned bot id for this env/instance

microservice_id.description: Optional pinned microservice id for this env/instance

storage.description: Optional instance-local storage / Iceberg fragment overlay

user_id.description: User ID of the data product owner

metadata.description: Additional metadata for the data product

created_by.description: User ID who created the data product

updated_by.description: User ID who last updated the data product

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when data product was created

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when data product was last updated

deleted_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when data product was deleted (soft delete)

output_queue_display_name.description: Observe label for the upstream writer's output queue when that writer does not declare its own. Deploy writes it onto the existing queue id and leaves bindings, checkpoints, and bot pause unchanged. The writer's output_queue_display_name wins when both are set.

schema.description: Product schema stored on the data product (object or JSON string). Read by medallion, metrics, and semantic bootstrap as dp.schema.

published_access_methods.description: Design-time permitted consumption methods (D3). Baseline event_stream (data product trigger) is always effective even when omitted; sync coalesces it into data_products.delivery.

odps_document.description: Canonical ODPS v4.1 document (`{ product: ... }`). Preferred for platform catalog, governance, and ecosystem interoperability. Validated in the dataproducts API; Loxtep-specific fields under product.custom.loxtep.
